# MintexCare

> MintexCare is a home healthcare agency based in Edison, New Jersey. It provides in-home personal care, companion care, skilled nursing, post-surgery care, respite care, live-in care and meal preparation for seniors and adults who need support at home, serving Middlesex, Monmouth, Somerset, Union and Mercer counties. Care is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

- Office: 2163 Oak Tree Road, Suite 204, Edison, NJ 08820
- Phone: (732) 268-5112
- Fax: (732) 515-9939
- Email: info@mintexcare.com
- Free in-home care consultation on request

## Core pages

- [Home](https://mintexcare.com/): Overview of MintexCare's home care services in Edison and Central New Jersey
- [Services](https://mintexcare.com/services): Home care services (hourly and live-in companion care, personal care, post-surgery care, rehab support, respite care, skilled nursing, meal preparation, medication reminders, errands, appointment scheduling, housekeeping, laundry, facility staffing) and specialized care (custodial care, wound care, post-stroke recovery, physical, occupational and speech therapy)
- [About](https://mintexcare.com/about): Who MintexCare is and how the agency works with families
- [Careers](https://mintexcare.com/careers): Open positions for Home Health Aides, CNAs, LPNs, RNs and companion caregivers in New Jersey
- [Contact](https://mintexcare.com/contact): Request a free consultation, office address and contact details, frequently asked questions

## Service area

- Middlesex County, NJ (office in Edison)
- Monmouth County, NJ
- Somerset County, NJ
- Union County, NJ
- Mercer County, NJ
